code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia with low arterial oxygen saturation and partial pressure, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin. There is mild metabolic acidosis (low pH), mild hypoalbuminemia, and elevated INR. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic respiratory insufficiency, likely inflammation or infection, and possible bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
